events.did: drove back from EON with a car trailing a block behind him and slipped past as he pulled up to his building
events.quote_anchor: The car trailed a block behind him as he drove back from EON.

events.did: took the elevator up five floors and let himself into his new apartment
events.quote_anchor: He took the elevator up five floors and let himself into his new home.

events.did: put a Bach record on his new record player
events.quote_anchor: He slipped a record from its sleeve and brought the needle to its edge, savoring the first few notes before Bach began to fill the room.

events.did: poured two cups of coffee and carried them down to the street
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel poured two cups and carried them down to the street.

events.did: offered one cup of the poisoned coffee to the soldier following him
events.quote_anchor: “I made coffee,” said Gabriel, taking a sip from one cup as he held the other out. “I thought you might like some.”

events.did: held the dying soldier’s head and felt the pulse fail
events.quote_anchor: He touched the man’s throat, as the pulse stuttered, then failed.

events.did: willed the dead soldier back to life and thought about Director Roy’s theory that an EO’s power is not arbitrary
events.quote_anchor: And as he willed the body back to life, he thought about Director Roy’s theory—that an EO’s power wasn’t arbitrary.

events.did: ordered Evanson to tell Helena Roy that he came home, went upstairs and stayed there
events.quote_anchor: “I want you to tell her that I came home, and went upstairs, and stayed there, and that, as far as you can tell, everything was normal.”

relations.did: was the stone-faced EON soldier in plain clothes who shadowed Helena and was following Gabriel
relations.quote_anchor: The man had traded his uniform for plain clothes, but Gabriel recognized the stone-faced soldier who seemed to shadow Helena.

relations.did: had orders to follow Gabriel and report back where he went and who he spoke with
relations.quote_anchor: “To follow you,” answered the soldier. “Report back exactly where you went. What you did. If you saw or spoke with anyone.”

relations.did: said Evanson must have angered Director Roy to be stuck on surveillance duty
relations.quote_anchor: “Well, Evanson, you must have pissed off Director Roy to get stuck doing this.”

relations.did: thought of himself on the collapsing stairs reaching for his wife and his son
relations.quote_anchor: Gabriel had only to think of himself on those collapsing stairs, reaching for his wife, his son, willing them to come to him
